mechanism: Infliximab (TNF-α inhibitor) increases infection risk and impairs immune function, while amikacin (aminoglycoside) carries nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risks that are potentiated in immunocompromised patients; concurrent use elevates serious infection risk including opportunistic infections.
action: Monitor renal function closely, ensure adequate hydration, use amikacin only when necessary for serious infections, monitor for signs of infection and ototoxicity, and consider therapeutic drug monitoring of amikacin levels.
